questions.question: A rectangle has an area of 54 square inches and a length of 6 inches. What is the width of the rectangle?
questions.explanation: Area = length × width. So, width = 54 ÷ 6 = 9 inches.

questions.question: A square and a triangle have the same area. The square has a side length of 8 inches, and the triangle has a base of 16 inches. What is the height of the triangle?
questions.explanation: The square's area is 8² = 64 square inches. Using A = ½bh, we have 64 = ½(16)h = 8h. Therefore, h = 8 inches.

questions.question: The figure below has a perimeter of 40 units. Line segments DE and BE each have length x. What is the value of x?
questions.explanation: The known side lengths are 7 units, 8 units, and 13 units. Set up the equation: 7 + 8 + 13 + x + x = 40. Therefore, 28 + 2x = 40, 2x = 12, and x = 6.
